Definition
[kappa solutions definition] Source: kleiner-lott

1. Definition 28.1\group Kleiner–Lott Local Estimates (cf. Definition of I.8.1) A flow is $\kappa $-collapsed at $(x_0,t_0)$ on scale $r$ if $|\Rm |\le r^{-2}$ on $B_{t_0}(x_0,r)\times [t_0-r^2,t_0]$ but $\vol (B_{t_0}(x_0,r))\le \kappa r^n$.
Theorem
[existence for kappa solutions]
